raw_definition: Observed direct local-rule obligation burden on the Korean-market row
burden_bearer_definition: The platform that directly internalizes compliance cost in Korea
positive_means: Korean platform in Korea bears heavier direct local-rule burden than foreign comparator in Korea
negative_means: Foreign comparator in Korea bears equal or greater direct local-rule burden
zero_means: No clear net local-rule burden difference in Korea
notes: Rebuilt from legacy regulation rows but scored only on Korea-market cells.

raw_definition: Difference in regulator reach, filing visibility, and enforceability between Korean and foreign platform rows in Korea
burden_bearer_definition: The platform more directly exposed to Korean enforcement reach
positive_means: Foreign platform is less reachable or less directly visible, leaving Korean platform relatively more exposed in Korea
negative_means: Foreign comparator is equally or more directly captured by Korean enforcement architecture
zero_means: No material reach asymmetry visible in Korea
notes: This is a new lane; many cells may initially remain bounded.

raw_definition: Incidence of creator- and artist-protection obligations in the Korean market
burden_bearer_definition: The platform that actually bears the cost after creator-protection rules are imposed
positive_means: Creator/artist protection cost falls more on Korean platform in Korea
negative_means: Creator/artist protection cost falls equally or more on foreign comparator in Korea
zero_means: No visible difference in creator-side burden incidence in Korea
notes: Normative intent is separated from burden incidence.

raw_definition: Recovery pressure, funding risk, cashflow pressure, and investment recovery burden observed on Korean-market comparison rows

positive_means: Korean platform in Korea faces longer recovery horizon or greater financing/cashflow pressure
negative_means: Foreign comparator in Korea faces greater recovery pressure
zero_means: No clear recovery-pressure difference in Korea
notes: Legacy risk axis was already directionally close, but now explicitly market-scoped.

raw_definition: Market-power transfer, switching pressure, bundle leverage, and discoverability pressure affecting Korea-market competition

positive_means: Korean platform in Korea faces stronger switching, bundle, or transfer pressure
negative_means: Foreign comparator in Korea faces stronger transfer pressure
zero_means: No clear market-transfer difference in Korea
notes: Legacy market axis had semantic leakage from proxy concentration and needs signed rebuild.

raw_definition: Average of signed core axes with thin-coverage exclusion
burden_bearer_definition: The Korean-versus-foreign Korea-market row as a whole

raw_definition: Core plus bounded reach/incidence side lanes
